artboards.title: Phone landscape · Urdu, right to left

annotations.text:
Layout A, split columns.
The switch is WIDTH, not orientation: at 600 px and wider the screen splits into a control column and a signal column. That covers small-phone landscape (640) and tablet portrait (820) with one rule, and laptops for free.
Left column holds the source buttons, the answer, the expected range and Calculate. It grows from 208 px on a small phone to 360 px on a tablet; below 240 px the button labels drop to icons.

One waveform, not two. Today the crop canvas and the result canvas draw the same ten seconds twice. Here Calculate leaves the marks on the crop canvas.
Decided: Calculate also snaps the detail range to the analysed window, so the marks are drawn at the window scale instead of smeared across a 30 s view. Dragging a crop handle outward zooms back out again.

Tablet and laptop: the surplus height goes to the long-clip overview strip and to a taller detail waveform, and past that the block stops growing and centres, because the app has a fixed amount to show. This is also where LONG_CLIP_S has to become a function of measured canvas width.

Urdu flips the columns wholesale: controls on the right, signal on the left. Time inside the waveform still runs left to right, and the digits of 1608 stay left to right. Real strings from src/i18n/messages/ur.ts.

Below 600 px the stack stays, close to today, with three changes: one waveform instead of two, the language picker moved out of the flow into an icon, and the transport and crop numbers on one row.
That is what makes the small phone fit: 360×640 comes to about 500 px of content with no scroll.

Light is the same layout on the light token set from index.css. Two values do not simply invert and are drawn here at their current values, so judge them: the 60% dim over the unselected audio, and the red record dot.
